# loggerkit (@mohamedhabibwork/loggerkit)

> Provider-first, runtime-portable TypeScript logging: a small core (levels, structured entries,
> sinks, formatters), pluggable transports, a pino-compatible facade, and adapters for hono,
> elysia, winston, loglevel, bunyan, log4js, morgan, and roarr.
> Zero runtime dependencies. Node.js >= 20, Bun, and Deno. Dual ESM/CJS with full TypeScript
> declarations.
> Adapter SDKs are optional peers; `winston` and `log4js` load theirs lazily via
> `importOptionalPeer()` with an install-hinting error.

## Install

```sh
npm install @mohamedhabibwork/loggerkit
```

Optional peers, only for the adapters that load them:

```sh
npm install winston   # adapters/winston
npm install log4js    # adapters/log4js (name-based auto-registration)
```

**Entrypoints**

- `@mohamedhabibwork/loggerkit` — core, `Logger`, sinks, formatters, factory, testing helpers
- `@mohamedhabibwork/loggerkit/sinks/console` · `sinks/memory` · `sinks/file` · `sinks/http`
- `@mohamedhabibwork/loggerkit/formatters`
- `@mohamedhabibwork/loggerkit/factory` · `@mohamedhabibwork/loggerkit/manager`
- `@mohamedhabibwork/loggerkit/pino-compat`
- `@mohamedhabibwork/loggerkit/adapters/{hono,elysia,winston,loglevel,bunyan,log4js,morgan,roarr}`
- `@mohamedhabibwork/loggerkit/testing`

## Quick start

```ts
import { createLogger } from "@mohamedhabibwork/loggerkit/factory";

const logger = createLogger({
  name: "app",
  level: "info",
  sinks: [{ kind: "console" }, { kind: "file", filePath: "./logs/app.log", maxBytes: 10_000_000 }],
});

logger.info("service started", { port: 3000 });
logger.child("db").warn("slow query", { durationMs: 812 });
```

## Semantics

- Levels order `trace < debug < info < warn < error < fatal` (weights 10..60). `parseLevel`
  trims/lowercases input and throws `InvalidLevelError` for anything else.
- `LogEntry`: `seq`, `time` (Date), `level`, `message`, `context` (logger bindings plus
  call-site fields), optional `name`, optional `error` (lifted from `context.error`).
- `Logger` filters by level before fan-out; a throwing sink is reported through `onError`
  (default: `console.error`) and never blocks the other sinks.
- `Logger.child(name, bindings)` adds bindings; names compose as `parent:child`; an empty name
  keeps the parent name.
- Sinks own rendering. File and HTTP sinks default to `jsonFormatter()`; the console sink emits
  its own NDJSON payload (`time`, `level`, `message`, `name`, context fields) unless a formatter
  is passed.
- `logger.error(message, error)` / `fatal` attach the Error to the entry; the JSON formatter
  serializes `name`, `message`, `stack`, and `cause` recursively.

## Sinks

| Sink | Entrypoint | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Console | `.../sinks/console` | Routes to `console.debug/info/warn/error` by level; own NDJSON payload unless a formatter is given |
| Memory | `.../sinks/memory` | Bounded buffer with `entries()`, `byLevel()`, `clear()`; used by `.../testing` |
| File | `.../sinks/file` | NDJSON append, zero-dep size-based rotation (`maxBytes`, `maxFiles` default 5), serialized writes |
| HTTP | `.../sinks/http` | Batched JSON POST via global `fetch`, timeout via AbortController, swallows failures after `console.warn`; `close()` flushes |
| Custom | any `{ name, write(entry) }` | See docs/custom-sinks.md |

## Formatters

- `jsonFormatter()` — one JSON object per line; reserved keys lifted, errors serialized.
- `prettyFormatter()` — single line: `HH:MM:SS.mmm LEVEL name: message key=value`.

## Factory and manager

- `createLogger(options)` — accepts concrete sinks or specs `{ kind: "console" | "memory" | "file" | "http" }`.
- `createMemoryLogger(options)` — returns `{ logger, memory }`.
- `LogManager` — named registry: `get(name)`, `setLevel(name, level)`, `setGlobalLevel(level)`, `names()`, `close()`.

## Pino-style API

```ts
import { pino } from "@mohamedhabibwork/loggerkit/pino-compat";

const log = pino({ name: "api" });
log.child({ requestId: "r1" }).info({ status: 200 }, "handled");
```

Emits pino-style field names (`msg`, numeric `level`, `time`, `err`, bindings) and writes NDJSON
to the console by default — pass `sinks` to redirect. `timestamp: false` omits `time`; a function
supplies it. The merging object comes first, like pino.

## Adapters

| Adapter | Entrypoint | SDK loading | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| hono | `.../adapters/hono` | none (structural) | `app.use(requestLogger(logger))`; exposes `c.set("logger")` |
| elysia | `.../adapters/elysia` | none (structural) | `new Elysia().use(elysiaLogger(logger))` |
| winston | `.../adapters/winston` | lazy (required) | `winston.add(await createWinstonTransport(logger))` |
| loglevel | `.../adapters/loglevel` | none (structural) | `Object.assign(log, createLoglevelMethods(logger))` |
| bunyan | `.../adapters/bunyan` | none (structural) | add `stream: createBunyanStream(logger)` to bunyan `streams` |
| log4js | `.../adapters/log4js` | lazy (only with `{ name }`) | `await createLog4jsAppender(logger, { name: "loggerkit" })` |
| morgan | `.../adapters/morgan` | none (structural) | `morgan("combined", { stream: createMorganStream(logger) })` |
| roarr | `.../adapters/roarr` | none (structural) | `ROARR.write = createRoarrSink(logger)` |

## Errors

- `LoggerKitError` — base class; missing optional peers throw it with the install command.
- `InvalidLevelError`, `UnknownSinkError`, `SinkClosedError`, `LoggerKitFactoryError`.

## Testing

`@mohamedhabibwork/loggerkit/testing` — `createCapture()` returns
`{ sink, entries, byLevel(), messages(), clear() }`; also re-exports `MemorySink`.

## Runtime support

Node.js >= 20 (global `fetch` required by the HTTP sink), Bun, Deno; dual ESM/CJS; zero runtime
dependencies; CI runs the gate on Node 20/22/24/26 plus a Bun/Deno smoke against `dist/`.

## Native backends (v0.2)
- ./sinks/elasticsearch — ElasticsearchSink: _bulk API, ECS docs, data streams, apiKey/basic auth, dated index tokens {yyyy}{MM}{dd}. Works with OpenSearch.
- ./sinks/logstash — LogstashSink: protocol tcp|tls (json_lines), udp (json), http.
- ./sinks/loki — LokiSink: push API, labels, labelKeys, tenantId.
- ./sinks/datadog — DatadogSink: HTTP intake v2.
- ./sinks/otlp — OtlpSink: OTLP/HTTP JSON logs.
- ./sinks/syslog — SyslogSink: RFC 5424 over udp/tcp/tls.
- ./sinks/gelf — GelfSink: Graylog GELF 1.1 over udp/tcp/tls/http.
- ./sinks/splunk — SplunkSink: HTTP Event Collector.
- All extend BatchingSink (batchSize, flushIntervalMs, maxQueueSize, retries, retryDelayMs, onError). Factory: { kind: "<backend>", options }.

## Core features
- Logger options: processors (redact, sample, rateLimit, enrich, minLevel), contextProvider.
- redact(options?) defaults to DEFAULT_REDACT_KEYS; options: enabled, useDefaultKeys, keys (added), excludeKeys, paths, censor (value | fn), remove, maxDepth. sample/rateLimit accept enabled.
- ./context — createLogContext() (AsyncLocalStorage): run, assign, get, provider.
- logger.time(message, level?) returns end(fields) → durationMs; logger.isLevelEnabled(level).
- Formatters: ecsFormatter, logstashFormatter, logfmtFormatter.
- KitLogger type: contract accepted by cachekit/queuekit/notifykit/storagekit managers.

## More adapters
- ./adapters/pino createPinoDestination, ./adapters/consola createConsolaReporter, ./adapters/debug createDebugLog,
  ./adapters/express expressLogger, ./adapters/fastify toFastifyLogger, ./adapters/nestjs NestLoggerService,
  ./adapters/console captureConsole.
